description: Send one of the user's own alert deliveries again (the same as POST /v1/alerts/deliveries/{id}/resend): the webhook or e-mail of an event that failed, expired or was lost on the receiving side. Take the delivery `id` from the `delivery` list of an event in alerts_events. Works whatever the delivery's status, up to 15 days after its event; it is queued for an immediate attempt with the same event id and a fresh signature, then retried as usual. Returns {id, status, result} where result is queued, already_queued or sending. Queued is a request, not a promise: the sender checks the rule and the channel again, so a delivery whose rule is off or whose channel is disabled or deleted is skipped again, and a paused channel delays the attempt. An error for a delivery that is not the user's own, is older than 15 days or is `unsupported` (its channel cannot carry that kind of event, so it would fail the same way).

delivery_id.description: The delivery `id` from an event's `delivery` list in alerts_events.
